meaning: GET route handlers under apps/web/src/app/api that resolve a session (currentUserOrNull/requireUser/cookies) yet return JSON without any approved cache/vary exit. This is a DEBT LEDGER, not a count: the door refuses both a NEW naked entry (a fresh private response that lies to caches) and a STALE entry (a path that has since become compliant but is still listed). The only way to change the list downward is to actually fix the route with privateJson / an explicit cache-control+vary, then remove its line in the same commit. Downward-only, like lint-debt.json.
approved_exits: privateJson(...) - server/http.ts, adds Vary: Cookie + private, no-store
apiJson(...) - server/http.ts, v1 exit, defaults no-store
bytesResponse(...) - server/http.ts, takes an explicit cache argument
a literal cache-control / 'vary' / NO_STORE in the route file
population_rule: a file is IN the population iff its source matches currentUserOrNull|requireUser|getCurrentUser|currentUser|SESSION_COOKIE|cookies() AND declares export async function GET. A file is COMPLIANT iff its whole source matches any approved exit token. Every population file that is NOT compliant MUST be listed here; every file listed here MUST be non-compliant.
